CHANGELOG (bench-corpus, plain text — unparsed by the indexer)
==============================================================

This file is windowed into fixed-size line chunks. It carries release-note prose
that does not exist as any symbol, so a query about a specific historical change
can only be answered from this text.

0.4.0
-----
- Added a token-bucket rate limiter to gate inbound requests.
- Introduced an LRU cache for hot price-book lookups.
- Switched all money math to integer cents to remove floating rounding drift.

0.3.0
-----
- Added Heron's-formula triangle area to the geometry module.
- Email validation now trims surrounding whitespace before checking shape.
- Sessions expire purely on elapsed-seconds arithmetic (no wall-clock lock).

0.2.0
-----
- Added exponential backoff with deterministic jitter for retries.
- Added Levenshtein edit distance for fuzzy string comparison.
- Added a breadth-first reachability count to the directed graph.

0.1.0
-----
- Initial corpus: billing, geometry, validation, pricing, and statistics.
- Feature-hash vector index plus FTS5 lexical index, fused with RRF.
